source: Founder timeline and certificate archive; all 21 original files preserved, plus a privacy-redacted copy of the supplied 2025 black belt certificate.

chapters.title: Mr. India · 2017

photo.alt: Unique Fitness mentor in a bodybuilding pose with a gold medal

chapters.caption: Mr. India 2017 · New Delhi
chapters.description: On the national stage, the mentor won the 60 kg bodybuilding category at Mr. India 2017 in New Delhi. The gold medal marked the beginning of a record built through discipline, preparation, and complete focus.

chapters.title: Mr. Tamil Nadu · 2017

photo.alt: Unique Fitness mentor receiving the Mr. Tamil Nadu 2017 overall championship trophy in Chennai

chapters.caption: Mr. Tamil Nadu 2017 · Overall champion
chapters.description: The same year, the journey continued at the state level. In Chennai, he was named the overall champion at Mr. Tamil Nadu 2017 — a title that showed the national win was part of a larger standard, not a single moment.

chapters.title: Mr. Asia · 2019

photo.alt: Unique Fitness mentor standing on the Mr. Asia 2019 podium in Pondicherry

chapters.caption: Mr. Asia 2019 · International podium
chapters.description: In 2019, the mentor earned a bronze medal on the Mr. Asia stage. The original podium photograph captures that moment; the certificate in the archive below records third place in the 60 kg category at the New Delhi championship.

chapters.title: Two titles · 2019

photo.alt: Black and white portrait of the mentor marked Mr. India 2017 and Mr. Asia 2019

chapters.caption: Mr. India 2017 · Mr. Asia 2019
chapters.description: This original portrait brings together the Mr. India 2017 and Mr. Asia 2019 milestones. The titles and the photographs are part of the same record: years of preparation carried forward into daily training.

chapters.title: The work continues

photo.alt: Unique Fitness mentor wearing a black training vest and weightlifting belt

chapters.caption: After the titles · The work continues
chapters.description: Competition gave the mentor a standard. Training gave him a daily practice. Away from the stage, the work stayed simple and demanding: return to the gym, build strength, and keep the promise made to yourself.

chapters.title: Pillars of Puducherry

photo.alt: The mentor receiving recognition at the Pillars of Puducherry ceremony

chapters.caption: Pillars of Puducherry · Recognition beyond sport
chapters.description: The story grew beyond competition. Recognition as one of the Pillars of Puducherry reflects a wider role: an athlete whose discipline, example, and commitment have become part of the community around him.
chapters.result: A local story with a larger reach

chapters.title: From record to responsibility

photo.alt: Mentor of Unique Fitness posing in the gym today

chapters.caption: 2026 · The mentor behind Unique Fitness
chapters.description: Today, that competition mindset is the foundation of Unique Fitness: a place where anyone can train with structure, consistency, and intent. The medals tell the history. The gym is where that history becomes useful to someone else.
chapters.result: Train with purpose · Build your own chapter
